items.stem: A firm's net multiplier primarily measures:

options.text: Revenue generated per unit of direct labour cost
options.rationale: Correct: the net multiplier relates net revenue to direct labour, a core firm financial metric.

options.text: The number of projects in the pipeline
options.rationale: Pipeline count is a workload measure, not the net multiplier.

options.text: The square footage of a building
options.rationale: Building area is a project metric, unrelated to the net multiplier.
Client creditworthiness is separate from the firm's net multiplier.

items.explanation: Correct: the net multiplier relates net revenue to direct labour, a core firm financial metric.

items.stem: The level of skill and care a reasonably prudent architect would exercise is the:

options.rationale: Correct: the standard of care defines the architect's professional duty.
A statute of repose limits the time to bring a claim.
Scope defines deliverables, not the care standard.
Fee basis concerns compensation, not duty of care.
